Hi, I’m Lan. I usually work at a small café in Da Nang, and I often
take photos after work. I’m interested in photography, but I’m
not very good at taking portraits. Yesterday, I went to a camera
shop with my friend Mai. We looked at two small cameras, and
the assistant explained the buttons to us. I liked the cheaper one,
but I didn’t buy it because I wanted to think about the price.
Right now, I’m sitting at home and looking for more information
online. Mai is sending me some photos from her camera. We’re
going to join a photography walk on Sunday. I’m excited about it,
but I’m worried about the rain. Tonight, I’m going to check the
weather and ask the organizer about the meeting place. Mai
doesn’t know how to get there, so I’ll send her the map. We want
to arrive early and try a new café before the walk.
Would you buy the camera now or wait? Why? What should Lan check first?
Tell your partner: one routine, one past event and one plan. Ask two follow-up questions.
